author: More Perfect Union
description:
Landlords in LA are evicting tenants to convert apartments into Airbnbs ahead of the 2028 Olympics.

They're using a legal loophole to evict people who should be able to stay in their homes, and upending countless lives in the process.

Producers: Eric Cheng, Leah Abrams
Editor: @kungaaaaaaaa
Videographer: Rachael Hastings Adair
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Airbnb hosts are already evicting seniors ahead of the 2028 Olympics
